items.title: Users turn to Nepal Telecom as private ISPs raise internet prices
items.blurb: The state-owned provider’s discounted annual 30 Mbps fibre package has drawn a surge of interest, but customers have raised concerns about delays, service quality and outdated routers.

items.title: Fresh signings deliver immediate results for NPL franchises amid late arrival and PCB-related chaos
items.blurb: From Hussain Talat’s match-winning bowling spell for Karnali to Chitwan’s airport-to-ground reinforcements, teams adapt swiftly to sudden changes.

items.title: Two-day weekend boosts tourism across hill stations
items.blurb: Introduced as an emergency measure to curb fuel consumption following the US-Israeli war on Iran, the new weekend policy has changed Nepalis’ travel habits and revitalised the country's hospitality sector.

items.title: Nuwakot flood victims form struggle committee to pressure federal government for help
items.blurb: Victims decry the lackadaisical approach from Kathmandu to the resettlement of displaced people, only prolonging their plight.

items.title: Chitwan Rhinos defeat Biratnagar Kings by eight runs
items.blurb: Kamal Singh Airee took four wickets as Biratnagar fell short of a 158-run target despite Andre Russell’s late 33 off 17 balls.

items.title: Biratnagar Kings need 158 to win
items.blurb: Losing the toss and batting first, Chitwan Rhinos managed 157/3 in the first innings on the back of Dawid Malan’s 70 off 50.

items.title: Nepal’s historic loss and damage allocation falls short of its needs
items.blurb: The UN fund has provisionally set aside 21.6 million for Nepal after the Rasuwa disaster, marking a first while covering less than 0.5 percent of the country’s estimated $4.7 billion recovery and reconstruction needs.
